evidence: Single deployable unit with all components in one repository (no separate services)
Clear separation into logical modules: 'situation' (core app), 'tests', 'venv' (dependencies)
Shared core 'models.py' and 'settings.py' indicating cohesive business logic
No inter-service communication patterns (e.g., no REST/gRPC clients, message queues, service discovery)
Database models use Google App Engine's db.Model (single datastore access point)
Static assets served from within the same app ('situation/static')
risks: Tight coupling risk due to shared data models across modules
Potential scalability limitations without service decomposition
Module boundaries may become blurred over time without strict enforcement
